response.original_title: More Than Freight: The Sollys Story
response.overview: From humble beginnings in Takaka, New Zealand, the Sollys story is one of hard work, resilience, family, and a deep connection to the community. Through decades of change, challenges, and growth, Sollys has become part of the fabric of the region, carrying more than just freight along the way.  Through personal stories, archival photographs, and a look back at the company’s history, More Than Freight: The Sollys Story celebrates the people, the milestones, and the legacy behind a family business built to last.
response.tagline: More than freight. A legacy built on family, hard work, and community.
response.title: More Than Freight: The Sollys Story
